companyFieldUpdates.name: Autopista Arco Norte, S.A. de C.V.
companyFieldUpdates.description: Autopista Arco Norte, S.A. de C.V., commonly known as Arco Norte, operates a 223-kilometer federal user-pay toll road across the State of Mexico, Hidalgo, Tlaxcala and Puebla. The concession was granted on December 21, 2005 and is scheduled to expire on December 20, 2065. IDEAL contributed its 99% Arco Norte interest to Promotora Punta Cometa, S.A. de C.V. in the partnership that closed on December 22, 2016; at close, CPP Investments held 29% of that vehicle and Ontario Teachers' held 20%, alongside IDEAL and a small Inbursa affiliate interest. Later FIDEAL restructuring changed the direct capitalization beneath the road, so current manager look-through percentages are not publicly disclosed and the 2016 percentages should not be presented as direct concessionaire stakes. Ontario Teachers' continues to list Arco Norte separately from IDEAL, supporting treatment as its own manager-level infrastructure holding. No manager exit, concession transfer, termination or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 19, 2026. Promotora Punta Cometa is the upstream holding vehicle; IDEAL Group and Pacifico Sur remain separate investments.
